{{Quote|One tribe of these Duloks are called the Korga, and they've been become quite adept in killing their cousins, the Ewoks.|A [[Rescue Our Lesser Brothers]] representative, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ac" />}}
The '''Korga''' were a tribe of [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] living on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]].<ref name="SWG:ac" /> Some members of the group lived within a [[Korga Cave|cave]] used as a hunting outpost.<ref name="SWG:KC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Korga Cave|Endor}}</ref> The Korga were known to be very hostile towards [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]],<ref name="SWG:ac" /> particularly with those of the [[Panshee]] and [[Gondula]] tribes.<ref name="FS">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Faction%20Standings|text=Faction Standings}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Korga were rumored to have contacts with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:Y">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|Corellian Corvette Pre-Quest: "Yondalla"}}</ref> After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the organization called [[Rescue Our Lesser Brothers]] decided to help the Ewok species from the violent Duloks. The organization determined that reducing the number of the Korga population could be beneficial for the Ewoks.<ref name="SWG:ac" /> Around the same time, the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]] was attacked by a group of Korga upon discovering a [[Solitary Hutt]] in the [[Desert of Salma/Legends|Desert of Salma]].<ref name="SWG:AEL7">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Explorer's Log (7/8)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Korga appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
